text: Came in the early morning and there was a lovely cool breeze up in the mountains - not busy at all. Loved the breath taking views from both the church and going up the fenicula (a train that goes up the mountain that has beautiful views - I recommend going on!!) There is a candle display in which you can light your own candle which is so beautiful to see. 🥹 So worth the car ride and would come back again. 😍😍

title: Montserrat was worth visiting
text: Montserrat and the surrounding countryside are a beautiful contrast to busy Barcelona. Our driver Roberto made the drive interesting.
author: Jeanne_L

title: Monserrat With Private Driver
text:
Montserrat is a "must see" and after taking 3 other "small group tours" we decided to make the day our own and take advantage of this one. 
It was a beautiful day and our driver (Jonathan) was excellent. He made suggestions and even took us to a small village to have lunch afterwards that turned out to be one of the highlights of our trip!
I would highly recommend this excursion!
FYI (I would also recommend that you have the driver take you to the top and then ride the cable car to the bottom. There is a lot of walking up hill involved if you take the cable car up).
author: Jayme1017

title: Montserrat Private Driver Tour
text: We (myself, my 35 year old son and daughter-in-law) chose to do an “on your own” private driver experience and it could not have been better. Our driver Jonathan was attentive and professional. He suggested lunch in a small village and it was perfect! I highly recommend this trip as Monserrat is a “must see”. We were dropped off on top and took the cable car down. Wow! What an experience. Thank you again Jonathan!

title: Montserrat Tour
text: Our driver, Pedro and guide, Lluis were both excellent. We also purchased the Museum Pass for €25 per person, which I HIGHLY recommend. Lluis helped us time our visit so we were able to take in the museum, the basilica (including a performance of the boys choir, and a visit to the Black Madonna, which was stunning. The museum exceeded expectations, the views from Montserrat were beautiful, and we were well taken care of. Pedro at Montpe Tours, who handled the booking was also helpful an efficient.

title: Everything great.
